CITYFUNDSSUBSIDYAGREEMENT This Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on the 13th day of February, 2026, by and 10459 and THE CITY OF NEW YORK ("City"), acting by and through its Department of Housing Preservation and Development ("HPD"), having its office at 100 Gold Street, New York, New York 10038. WHEREAS, on the date hereof, the Owner has purchased legal title to certain real property described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the“Premises")which conveyance shall be subject to thisAgreement forthereasons set forthbelow;and WHEREAS,the acquisitionof thePremisespursuant to theCity'sHomebuyersDownpayment City ("City Funds") in the amount of One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($100,000.00); and WHEREAs, the Premises will be subject to the owner occupancy requirements of the HomeFirst programdefined in theEnforcementMortgage;and NOwTHEREFORE,thepartiesdoherebyagreeasfollows: 1. RestrictionPeriod The terms of the restrictions set forth in this Agreement ("Restriction Period") shall run until the fifteenth(15th)anniversaryofthedatethereof. OwnerOccupancyRequirement During the RestrictionPeriod,Owner shall (i) continuously occupy not less than one dwelling unit in the Premises as Owner's sole primary residence,(i)reside and sleep in not less than one dwelling unit in the Premises not less than twohundred and seventy (270) days per year (if Owner be counted as a day spent in the dwelling unit for the purpose of this requirement), (ii) not lease units, Owner may lease dwelling units other than the dwelling unit occupied by Owner but may not permit the dwelling units to be used for transient occupancy), (iv) identify the Premises as Owner's sole address/residence on any tax return, voter registration, driver's license or other permit tooperate a motorvehicle,and allother documents stating Owner'scurrentaddress or residence,(v)[not own or lease (except for in connection with a short term vacation rental)]any through inheritance, Owner shall sell such property within one year from the date it is acquired), and(vi)annuallycomplete and submit toHPD anowner occupancycertification inthe form annexedheretoasExhibitAandmadeaparthereof. 1
